scientific_integrity: All displayed formulas follow from explicit perfect-matching counts and convergent total-variation estimates. The reproducibility code directly enumerates only q=1..7, not an infinite family. No independent audit or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Linear words with q labeled letters appearing exactly twice; not cyclic, fixed-alphabet iid, general multiset compositions, or noncontiguous shuffle factors. Finite enumeration only tests small q; proofs establish general claims. The asymptotic error constant is not optimized and equivalence under unindexed matching terminology remains possible.
title: Poisson law and rare long Abelian squares in random double-occurrence words
